name: IEC 60320 C13/C14
description: Appliance coupler for class I equipment (with earth) and cold conditions. The C13 connector on the cord mates with the C14 appliance inlet. The face is a rectangle with the two top corners chamfered and the earth contact at top centre.

notes: The C14 face is drawn from the front view of the Schurter 6010 datasheet and the C13 face from the front view of the Schurter 4782 datasheet (chamfered corners, earth contact at centre set towards the chamfers, two pole contacts). Proportions are scaled from these drawings; the IEC 60320-3 standard sheet dimensions were not reviewed.

The Schurter 6010 datasheet marks L and N only on the terminal (rear) side; no cited source assigns line and neutral on the mating face, and IEC 60320-3 was not reviewed, so both drawings label the pole contacts L/N.
The current edition of IEC 60320-3 was not checked.
